title: Market scanner using IBKR's scanner categories, disabled when IBKR isn't available
description: Ch. 56 describes scanning a large universe the user doesn't already track (S&P 500, an industry group, etc.) to discover new candidates -- distinct from the watchlist (a curated list of tickers already tracked) and the ticker detail view (analyzes one already-chosen ticker). Per explicit product decision: this uses IBKRProvider.run_scanner's predefined categories (52-week-high/low, hot-by-volume, top % gainers/losers, etc. -- confirmed present in get_scanner_params's option list) when the gateway is enabled and available, and the feature is simply unavailable (a clear 'scanner unavailable, IBKR not connected' state, never a hard error) otherwise. Elder's own bespoke custom-pattern scanner (a precursor-to-divergence detector built with a programmer) is explicitly NOT in scope here -- that remains a separate, much larger idea in docs/ideas.md if ever pursued; this task only wires up IBKR's own existing scan categories.

checklist.step: Add an endpoint exposing the available scanner categories (from IBKRProvider.get_scanner_params) and an endpoint to run a scan (via IBKRProvider.run_scanner), both returning a clear 'unavailable' response (not an error) when IBKR isn't enabled/available -- reuse the same gateway-availability pattern backend-ibkr-status-endpoint establishes.

Decide and record which of IBKR's scan categories to expose as the initial curated set (vs. exposing the raw params list as-is) and any default negative filters (e.g. a minimum average-daily-volume floor, per ch.56's own liquidity-filter advice) -- record the rationale.
Respect IBKRProvider's existing client-side rate limits (1 req/sec for run_scanner, 15-min cache for get_scanner_params) -- do not add a second, conflicting throttle layer.
Unit tests mocking IBKRProvider for: IBKR disabled, gateway unavailable, a successful scan, and the rate-limited case.
